simple.meaning: סַאסְּאָה (çaʼçᵉʼâh) is a Hebrew action word meaning “measurement , i.e. moderation.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Isaiah, beginning at Isaiah 27:8. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to סַאסְּאָה (H5432) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: סַאסְּאָה (çaʼçᵉʼâh) / H5432 is traced through Isaiah 27:8 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.full: H5432. sese [ סֵאסֵא ] verb Pilpel , whence Infinitive בְּסַאסְאָהּ ( בְּסַאסְּאָה ᵑ0 ) Isa 27:8 = by driving her (it) away (conjecture from || בְּשַׁלְּחָהּ ), according to Hi Ew Di Du Che Hpt AmRV m ; > = סְאָה בִּסְאָה by the se'ah, the se'ah , i.e. (Ges § 123c , 133k) by exact measure Vrss (not ᵐ5 ), Ges De compare AV RV, which is probably Rabbinic conceit. (On formative compare טאטא , and see Ges § 55f . Sta §§ 112 a Anm. 2; 238. )

occurrences.englishText: In measure, when you send them away, you contend with them. He has removed them with his rough blast in the day of the east wind.
